claim: Le Coquillage holds 3 Michelin stars (2025/2026) and sits in Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes, Ille-et-Vilaine, Brittany.
quote: Le Coquillage – Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes – a MICHELIN Guide Restaurant

claim: Le Coquillage is housed inside Château Richeux, a 1920s villa overlooking Mont-Saint-Michel Bay, 5 km from Cancale on the D155.
quote: Château Richeux is located 5 km (3 miles) from Cancale on the road to Mont Saint-Michel (D155).

claim: Château Richeux is the 11-room, 2-apartment Relais & Châteaux hotel attached to Le Coquillage; the wider estate includes the Bains Celtiques spa, a bakery and a spice shop.
quote: 11 rooms and 2 luxurious, cosy apartments, as well as the restaurant Le Coquillage … a unique spa called the Bains Celtiques.

claim: Les Rimains is a 1988-opened Roellinger boutique hotel in a 1920s house on the Cancale cliffs once owned by a composer; La Ferme du Vent (2016) added kled lodges.
quote: Les Rimains, in a 1920s house on the Cancale cliffs, once home to a great composer … La Ferme du Vent (2016).

claim: La Ferme du Vent offers five Celtic shelters (kleds) built in wood and raw stone, with panoramic bay views and Celtic Baths spa.
quote: five Celtic shelters, called kled in Breton, carefully restored to preserve the horizon and authenticity of the site.

claim: La Ferme du Vent's kleds have no Wi-Fi or TV by design and are aimed at slow off-grid retreats with personal kitchen drop-offs.
quote: The architecture features an absence of Wi-Fi or television, creating absolute serenity.

claim: Le Manoir des Douets Fleuris is a 17th-century granite manor in Cancale once owned by a French East India Company merchant-weaver family.
quote: 17th-century manor in Cancale once owned by a family of merchant-weavers from the French East India Company.

claim: Guests highlight the manor's heated outdoor pool, hot tub, hospitable hosts (Émilie and Damien) and quiet garden setting.
quote: A wonderful place to stay, excellently staffed, a gorgeous pool and hot tub, top-notch food in the morning, generous hosts and comfortable beds.

claim: Maison Tirel-Guérin (Domaine du Limonay, The Originals Collection) is a 4-star country estate in Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes dating to 1936, with covered heated pool, sauna and tennis.
quote: Maison Tirel Guérin, The Originals Collection … 4-star hotel … dates back to 1936.

claim: Maison Tirel-Guérin's on-site restaurant La Gouesnière holds 1 Michelin star (awarded 2016) and the property sits roughly 7.5 miles from Saint-Malo.
quote: The hotel's restaurant La Gouesnière was awarded 1 Michelin star in 2016.

claim: Hôtel Elizabeth, built in 1600, is the oldest dated building inside Saint-Malo's walls; breakfast is served in a vaulted stone cellar.
quote: Built in 1600, it is the oldest dated building in the city center of Saint-Malo … breakfast in the basement … under vaulted ceilings.

claim: Hôtel Le Nautilus is a 17th-century building inside the walls of Saint-Malo, fully renovated in 2025 with 15 soundproofed rooms including attic rooms under exposed beams.
quote: Housed in a 17th-century building, fully renovated and carefully soundproofed.

claim: Hôtel Le Grand Bé is a 4-star intra-muros hotel with 55 rooms, 50 m from Bon Secours beach; its spa occupies 17th-century vaulted cellars.
quote: The basement contains 17th century vaults that house a wellness area.

claim: Le Grand Hôtel des Thermes, a Belle Époque hotel from 1881 facing Sillon beach, has 177 rooms and one of France's most established marine thalassotherapy spas.
quote: The Grand Hôtel des Thermes in Saint-Malo, built at the end of the 19th century … embodies the pure Belle Époque style … since 1881.

claim: Château Hôtel du Colombier is a 1715 malouinière built by a Compagnie des Indes ship owner, set in a 6-hectare park with rose garden, chapel and pond.
quote: The house was built in 1715 by a ship owner of the Compagnie des Indes de Saint-Malo.

claim: Castelbrac occupies a 1930s cliff-edge villa in Dinard (formerly a marine research station) with 25 sea-facing rooms over Prieuré bay.
quote: the Castelbrac hotel at Dinard occupies a magnificent 1930s villa … 25 sea-facing rooms.

claim: Castelbrac's service is described as relaxed and unobtrusive rather than performative-luxury, with a private yacht for Channel-Islands excursions.
quote: Service at Castelbrac is sensitive, sympathetic, and unobtrusive … excursion on the hotel's beautiful hand-built yacht.

claim: Saint-Malo to Cancale is roughly 15–17 km by road, ~20 minutes drive.
quote: Distance Saint-Malo à Cancale … km, durée, coûts.

claim: Saint-Malo taxis apply a night surcharge (tarif B / nuit) from 19:00 to 07:00 and on Sundays/holidays, raising the per-km rate ~50%.
quote: Tarifs – Taxis Saint Malo … nuit … dimanche et jours fériés.

claim: Compagnie Corsaire's Saint-Malo ↔ Dinard sea-bus crosses the estuary in ~10 minutes and runs until midnight on selected dates, useful for a Castelbrac return.
quote: the fastest way to cross between Saint-Malo and Dinard … takes just 10 minutes.

claim: Saint-Malo Tourism lists Château Richeux as the Maisons de Bricourt 3-star hotel in Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes attached to Le Coquillage.
quote: Château Richeux (Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes) … Saint-Malo – Mont-Saint-Michel Bay – Tourism.

claim: Hôtel des Marins is a 3-star intra-muros hotel with 49 rooms renovated in 2019, decorated around three color harmonies and maritime photography by Pierrick Contin.
quote: 49 rooms and 4 apartments feature a warm atmosphere combined with 3 harmonies of colors.

claim: Château Richeux's nightly rates run roughly €280–€530 for rooms and €470+ for suites (recent guest reports).
quote: Château Richeux … reviews … pricing.
